skill.name: verification-before-completion
skill.description: Requires fresh verification evidence before any completion, fix, build, test, or PR success claim.
skill.summary: Run verification commands and cite results before claiming work is complete.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

content.value_statement: Teams lose trust when completion claims are not backed by fresh evidence. This skill makes agents run, read, and cite verification before reporting success.
actual_capabilities: Requires fresh verification before success or completion claims.
Prompts agents to identify the command that proves each claim.
Directs agents to read full command output and exit status.
Separates verified facts from assumptions and partial checks.
Adds independent review after delegated agent work.
limitations: It does not provide project-specific test commands.
It cannot guarantee checks pass if the repository is broken.
It relies on tool access to run verification commands.
It does not replace human review for release decisions.

use_cases.title: Before Status Updates
use_cases.description: Verify tests, builds, or requirements before reporting task completion to a teammate.

use_cases.title: Before Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Run relevant checks and report evidence before opening or updating a pull request.

use_cases.title: After Agent Delegation
use_cases.description: Inspect delegated work and verify results before trusting an agent success report.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Before Replying
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check before a completion claim.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use verification-before-completion. Before you say this task is complete, identify the command that proves it, run it, and report the result.

prompt_templates.title: Check A Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused verification for a bug fix.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use verification-before-completion for this bug fix. Run the smallest relevant test, read the output, and state whether the symptom is fixed.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare A PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Team workflow before pull request creation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use verification-before-completion before opening a PR. Run tests, lint, and build as applicable, then summarize evidence and any remaining gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Delegated Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review after another agent reports success.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use verification-before-completion after a subagent reports success. Inspect the diff, run independent verification, and report only evidence-backed status.

output_examples.input: A developer says the test suite should pass after a change.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the test command, runs it, reads the result, and reports pass counts or failures before claiming success.

output_examples.input: A team is ready to open a pull request.
output_examples.output: The assistant runs relevant checks, confirms exit status and failure counts, then lists verified results and unverified areas.

output_examples.input: A subagent reports that a refactor is complete.
output_examples.output: The assistant inspects the diff, verifies expected files changed, runs checks, and reports actual status.

best_practices: Run the full relevant check in the current session.
Report exact evidence, including pass counts, exit status, or failures.
State unverified areas clearly when checks are partial or blocked.
anti_patterns: Claiming work is done based on confidence or code inspection alone.
Using old command output as proof for a new change.
Trusting delegated agent results without inspecting and verifying them.

faq.question: Does this skill run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It instructs the agent to choose and run the relevant verification command.

faq.question: Can it be used outside coding tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It works for any task where a claim needs fresh evidence.

faq.question: Does it define which command to run?
faq.answer: No. The agent must infer the correct command from the project context.

faq.question: Why require fresh verification?
faq.answer: Fresh verification prevents stale results from being used after code or requirements change.

faq.question: What if verification is impossible?
faq.answer: The agent should state the blocker and avoid claiming success.

faq.question: Does it replace code review?
faq.answer: No. It improves evidence in status reports, but human review may still be required.
